<Why>
The site cannot reach the lab, so it cannot ask the lab whether a step worked. A token both sides compute from the lab seed lets the site check a pasted value without any network link.
</Why>

<Idea>
The beacon publishes a token per slot; the site computes the same token from the seed in the settings.
</Idea>

<Do>
1. Find the beacon log line for slot log-m90-1.
2. Paste its token below.
</Do>

<Done>
The check says passed.
</Done>

<Question id="q-m90-s06" answer="b">
What does the site need to check a token?

- A network link to the lab

  There is none, on purpose.

- The lab seed

  Right: the token is computed from the seed and the slot id.

- The learner password

  The site has no accounts.

- A copy of the logs

  Only the pasted token is checked.
</Question>
